nodes.label: Fundamental Factors — P/E, P/B, ROE, etc.  Implements fundamental analysis facto
Price-to-Earnings ratio factor.      Formula: close / eps     Lower P/E may indi
Price-to-Book ratio factor.      Formula: close / book_value_per_share
Price-to-Sales ratio factor.      Formula: market_cap / revenue (or close / sale
Return on Equity factor.      Formula: net_income / shareholders_equity
Return on Assets factor.      Formula: net_income / total_assets
Debt-to-Equity ratio factor.      Formula: total_debt / shareholders_equity
Earnings growth rate factor.      Formula: (eps_t - eps_t-1) / |eps_t-1|
Dividend yield factor.      Formula: dividends_per_share / close
Return instances of all implemented fundamental factors.
